nominal clause | ˈnɑːmɪnl | n.名词性从句

relative clause | klɔːs | n.定语从句

grammar.text:
But what _ _ _ exact  _ _ _ _ the mission? It is the Delta Force,
But what is the exact unit tasked with the mission?It is the Delta Force,

grammar.name: ..., while...
grammar.text: 【含义】：对比

examples.text: The tiny hermit crab uses its claws mostly for feeding and protection inside shells, while the burly coconut crab wields its massive pinchers to crack open coconut

grammar.name: much of  + 抽象名词
grammar.text:
【含义】：很多什么
【成分】：名词

examples.text:
he brought so [much of his Maori culture] into the Metkayina
【很多什么】他带来了[很多毛利文化]，融入他的角色里
---
【much of  + 很多什么】他带来了很多毛利文化，融入他的角色里
so much of his Maori culture

Hitler's forces conquered much of Europe
【很多什么】希特勒的军队征服了欧洲大部分地区
---
【much of  + 很多什么】希特勒的军队征服了欧洲大部分地区
Hitler's forces conquered much of Europe

grammar.name: What is it like doing/to do
grammar.text:
【含义】：感觉如何？
【注意】：后面的非谓语动词引导一个句子，这个句子等于形式主语 it
【例子】：相当于 What was working with all the new actors like

examples.text: What was it like working with all the new actors?

grammar.name: 插入式疑问
grammar.text:
【含义】：特殊疑问句 + 陈述句。
【注意】：它是插进来的，不属于句子结构的一部分

examples.text: How do you think your character is handling being a parent?

grammar.name: How is the A different from the B?
grammar.text: 【含义】：A 与 B 有什么不同

examples.text: How was the filming of Avatar: The Way of Water different from the first film?

grammar.name: trouble with sth
grammar.text:
【含义】：某方面的麻烦
【翻译】：...麻烦

examples.text:
do scenes that we have enough trouble with on dry land
【某方面的麻烦】然后拍那些我们在陆地上都已经很难的戏
---
【trouble with sth ↔ 某方面的麻烦】然后拍那些我们在陆地上都已经很难的戏
do scenes that we have enough trouble with on dry land

grammar.name: wait for sth
grammar.text: 【含义】：等什么东西

examples.text:
you should wait for about three to five minutes
【等什么东西】你应该等大概三五分钟
---
【wait for ↔ 等什么东西】你应该等大概三五分钟
you should wait for about three to five minutes

grammar.name: come prep sth
grammar.text:
【含义】：物品以什么方式出现
【结构】：come in/with/under sth
【翻译】：直接翻译后面的介词

examples.text:
this small plate that goes under your teacup is called a saucer
【物品以什么方式出现】放在茶杯下面的这个小碟子叫做茶碟
---
【come in/with/under sth ↔ 物品以什么方式出现】茶杯会带一个小碟子
a teacup will come with a small plate

a teacup will come with a small plate
【物品以什么方式出现】茶杯会带一个小碟子
---
【come in/with/under sth ↔ 物品以什么方式出现】茶杯会带一个小碟子
a teacup will come with a small plate

loose leaf tea will come in a container
【物品以什么方式出现】散装茶叶将装在一个容器里
---
【come in/with/under sth ↔ 物品以什么方式出现】散装茶叶将装在一个容器里
loose leaf tea will come in a container

grammar.name: depend on sth
grammar.text: 【含义】：根据什么

examples.text:
depending on who you talk to, the word can be pronounced differently
【根据什么】[根据你讲话的对象]，这个词可以发不同的音
---
【depend on sth ↔ 根据什么】根据你讲话的对象
depending on who you talk to

grammar.name: break sth apart in half
grammar.text:
【含义】：掰成两半
【注意】：apart 与 in half 共同修饰动词 break，而不是 in half 修饰 apart。介词不能修饰副词。

examples.text:
You will break them apart in half and you can add cream and jam
【掰成两半】[你将它们掰成两半]，然后你可以放奶油和果酱
---
【break sth apart in half ↔ 掰成两半】你将它们掰成两半
You will break them apart in half

grammar.name: get away with sth
grammar.text: 【含义】：从...全身而退

examples.text:
Uranus wouldn't [get away with] this assault so easily
【从...全身而退】这次袭击，天王星无法轻易全身而退
---
【get away with sth ↔ 从...全身而退】这次袭击，天王星无法轻易全身而退
Uranus wouldn't get away with this assault so easily

grammar.name: A is XXX away from B
grammar.text: 【含义】：A 距离 B 多远

examples.text:
Uranus [is] 3 billion km [away from] us
【A 距离 B 多远】天王星距离我们 30 亿公里
---
【A is XXX away from B ↔ A 距离 B 多远】天王星距离我们 30 亿公里
Uranus is 3 billion km away from us

grammar.name: jump out at sb
grammar.text: 【含义】：突然跳出来吓某人一跳

examples.text:
horror movies have things that [jump out at you]
【突然跳出来吓某人一跳】恐怖电影里总会有些东西突然跳出来吓你一跳
---
【jump out at sb ↔ 突然跳出来吓某人一跳】恐怖电影里总会有些东西突然跳出来吓你一跳
horror movies have things that jump out at you

grammar.name: be able to do
grammar.text:
【含义】：表示能力
【注意】：是更正式、更灵活的 can

examples.text:
I don't trust that I'll [be able to] get her back at the end of night
【能力】我不相信晚上[我能把它弄回来]
---
【be able to do ↔ 能力】我不相信晚上我能把它弄回来
I'll be able to get her back

grammar.name: have been sth
grammar.text:
【含义】：一直是什么
【注意】：
-没有 have been being sth 这样的结构，因为 be 是状态动词，不是可持续的动作
-如果是可持续动作，要使用 have been doing sth

examples.text:
recently some of the most famous fantasy movies [have been Harry Potter and Avatar]
【一直是什么】最近一些有名的奇幻电影包括《哈利·波特》和《阿凡达》
---
【have been sth ↔ 一直是什么】与恐怖电影截然不同
recently some famous fantasy movies have been Harry Potter and Avatar

grammar.name: as opposed to sth
grammar.text: 【含义】：而非什么

examples.text:
Thriller makes you consider things psychologically [as opposed to horror movies] that just come right out and scare you with things
【而非什么】惊悚片会让你从心理层面思考问题，[而非恐怖片那样]，只是直接用各种东西吓唬你
---
【as opposed to sth ↔ 而非什么】而非恐怖片那样
as opposed to horror movies that

grammar.name: be afraid of sth
grammar.text:
【含义】：害怕某个东西
【结构】：be afraid/scared of sth

examples.text:
[are] you [scared of] horror movies
【害怕某个东西】你害怕恐怖电影吗
---
【be afraid/scared of sth ↔ 害怕某个东西】你害怕恐怖电影吗
are you scared of horror movies

grammar.name: right 核心含义
grammar.text:
【含义】：直的
【翻译】：径直、直接

examples.text:
[come right out] and scare you
【径直、直接】[突然出来]吓唬你
---
【right 核心含义 ↔ 径直、直接】突然出来吓唬你
come right out

the kitty police will come [right] through that front door
【径直、直接】猫警会[从前门直接进来]
---
【right 核心含义 ↔ 径直、直接】猫警会从前门直接进来
come right through that front door

grammar.name: try doing
grammar.text:
【含义】：尝试做
【注意】：它表示建议。try to do 表示努力，意思完全不同

examples.text:
If you are looking for some entertainment with some great action, [try watching] an action movie
【尝试做】如果你想找一部动作精彩、娱乐性十足的电影，[尝试看一部动作电影]
---
【try doing ↔ 尝试做】尝试看一部动作电影
try watching an action movie

grammar.name: got to
grammar.text:
【含义】：不得不做某事，不然
【翻译】：得

examples.text:
if I don't grab her, she'll stay there all day until she sees movement, so I [got to] get her
【得】我得把它抓来
---
【got to ↔ 得】我得
I got to get her

I [got to] flush all the toilets? 
【得】我得冲所有的厕所？
---
【got to ↔ 得】我得
I got to flush all the toilets?

grammar.name: stop sb from doing sth
grammar.text: 【含义】：阻止某人做某事

examples.text:
the bad weather does not [stop] the cats [from doing] their jobs
【阻止某人做某事】坏天气无法阻止猫做它们的工作
---
【stop sb from doing sth ↔ 阻止某人做某事】坏天气无法阻止猫做它们的工作
the bad weather does not stop the cats from doing their jobs

grammar.name: take offense
grammar.text: 【含义】：生气

examples.text:
don't take offense to me showing these clips
【生气】不要生气我展示这些镜头
---
【take offense ↔ 生气】不要生气我展示这些镜头
don't take offense to me showing these clips

grammar.name: catch sth on film
grammar.text:
【含义】：拍下来
【结构】：catch/get sth on film

examples.text:
I've seen the cats get into some precarious situations and [I don't always catch it on film]
【拍下来】我曾多次看到猫咪陷入危险境地，但[我并非总能拍到]
---
【catch sth on film ↔ 拍下来】我并非总能拍到
I don't always catch it on film

grammar.name: be going to do
grammar.text:
【含义】：将要实施已经想好的事。是加强版的 be doing
【翻译】：要、不翻译
【注意】：
-going to 常读成 gonna 以凸显将之意
-will 翻译为会，但没有 be going to do 确定性高

examples.text:
the thing about running a farm is that you['re going to] have some kind of rodent activity
【要】经营农场的一大问题就是，[你会有一些鼠患]
---
【be going to do ↔ 要】你会有一些鼠患
you're going to have some kind of rodent activity

grammar.name: all sorts of things
grammar.text:
【含义】：各种各样的东西
【注意】：看作复数

examples.text:
all sorts of sauce recipes
【各种各样的东西】各种各样的酱料秘方
---
【all sorts of things ↔ 各种各样的东西】各种各样的酱料秘方
all sorts of sauce recipes

the job is to control all sorts of pests
【各种各样的东西】工作是控制各种各样的害虫
---
【all sorts of things ↔ 各种各样的东西】工作是控制各种各样的害虫
the job is to control all sorts of pests

grammar.name: keep sb in line
grammar.text: 【含义】：让某人守规矩

examples.text:
he doesn't take no guff from any of the other cats and [keeps them in line]
【让某人守规矩】他不会听其他任何猫的废话，[让它们守规矩]
---
【keep sb in line ↔ 让某人守规矩】让它们守规矩
keeps them in line

grammar.name: do not take no guff from sb
grammar.text:
【含义】：不接受某人的废话、不吃这一套
【结构】：across the world/globe

examples.text:
he doesn't take no guff from any of the other cats
【不接受某人的废话】他不会听其他任何猫的废话
---
【do not take no guff from sb ↔ 不接受某人的废话】他不会听其他任何猫的废话
he doesn't take no guff from any of the other cats

grammar.name: across the world
grammar.text:
【含义】：在世界各地
【结构】：across the world/globe

examples.text:
[as I look in this arena and across the globe], a piece of you died
【在世界各地】[当我环顾这片赛场，放眼全球]，我感到你们的一部分已经逝去
---
【across the world/globe ↔ 在世界各地】当我环顾这片赛场，放眼全球
as I look in this arena and across the globe

why [across the world] there's a woman just like me
【在世界各地】为什么[世界各地]都有像我一样的女人
---
【across the world/globe ↔ 在世界各地】为什么世界各地都有像我一样的女人
across the world

grammar.name: in addition to sth
grammar.text:
【含义】：在...的基础之上
【注意】：虽然有时翻译为除了，但前后是加的关系，不是排除的关系

examples.text:
shipping fee is extra money [in addition to] the cost of the actual item 
【在...的基础之上】运费是在实物花费基础之上的额外费用
---
【in addition to sth ↔ 在...的基础之上】运费是在实物花费基础之上的额外费用
shipping fee is extra money in addition to the cost of the actual item

grammar.name: other than sth
grammar.text: 【含义】：除了某个东西

examples.text:
international shipping means that a company will ship to [a country other than its origins]
【除了某个东西】国际运输是指公司将货物运送到[原产国以外的国家]
---
【other than sth ↔ 除了某个东西】原产国以外的国家
a country other than its origins

we [think of] worms [as] being gross insects
【认为...是...】我们认为蠕虫是恶心的昆虫
---
【think of...as... ↔ 认为...是...】我们认为蠕虫是恶心的昆虫
we think of worms as being gross insects

grammar.name: suffer from sth
grammar.text: 【含义】：遭受什么困扰

examples.text:
I'm suffering from grief
【遭受】我正承受着悲痛
---
【suffer from ↔ 遭受】我正承受着悲痛
I'm suffering from grief

you are suffering from depression
【遭受】你患有抑郁症
---
【suffer from ↔ 遭受】你患有抑郁症
you are suffering from depression

grammar.name: be afraid to do
grammar.text:
【含义】：害怕干什么
【结构】：be afraid/scared to do

examples.text:
next time you feel the urge to pee, don't [be afraid to take a break] and go to the bathroom
【害怕干什么】下次感觉想撒尿，[不要害怕停下来]，去上个厕所
---
【be afraid/scared to do ↔ 害怕干什么】不要害怕停下来
don't be afraid to take a break

grammar.name: be like
grammar.text:
【含义】：像
【注意】：该结构就是我们常说的像，即本质上像。如果看着像则使用 it looks like

examples.text:
a popsicle is like a frozen dessert on a stick
【像】雪糕像一个在棍上的冻的点心
---
【be like ↔ 像】雪糕像一个在棍上的冻的点心
a popsicle is like a frozen dessert on a stick

a bladder [is like] a big balloon
【像】膀胱像一个大气球
---
【be like ↔ 像】膀胱像一个大气球
a bladder is like a big balloon

grammar.name: develop...into a habit
grammar.text: 【含义】：养成...为一种习惯

examples.text:
if you have [developed] this [into a habit], then it's better to get rid of it
【养成...为一种习惯】如果[你已经将此养成了一种习惯]，那么最好戒掉它
---
【develop...into a habit ↔ 养成...为一种习惯】如果你已经将此养成了一种习惯
you have developed this into a habit

grammar.name: what matters is
grammar.text:
【含义】: 重要的是
【注意】：what 被看成单数，所有使用第三人称 matters ，类似的还有 it doesn't matter

examples.text:
[what matters] to your brain is how you respond to that stress
【重要的是】对你的大脑来说，重要的是你如何应对这种压力
---
【what matters is ↔ 重要的是】重要的是你如何应对这种压力
what matters to your brain is how you respond to that stress

grammar.name: turn sth into sth
grammar.text: 【含义】: 将什么变成什么

examples.text:
the strange power to [turn] men [into] stone
【将什么变成什么】将人变成石头的奇异力量
---
【turn sth into sth ↔ 将什么变成什么】将人变成石头的奇异力量
the strange power to turn men into stone

[turning] them [into] a salty liquid
【将什么变成什么】将它们变成咸液体
---
【turn sth into sth ↔ 将什么变成什么】
turning them into a salty liquid

grammar.name: see...as...
grammar.text:
【含义】: 视作
【结构】: see/view...as...

examples.text:
if you can [view] those situations [as] challenges you can control
【视作】如果你能视这些情况为你能控制的挑战
---
【see...as... ↔ 视作】
if you can view those situations as challenges you can control

Medusa [was seen as] vice incarnate
【视作】美杜莎被视作邪恶的化身
---
【see...as... ↔ 视作】
Medusa was seen as vice incarnate

grammar.name: be no longer adjective
grammar.text: 【含义】: 不再处于某个状态

examples.text:
they feel they [are no longer in danger]
【不再处于某个状态】他们觉得[自己不再处于危险之中]
---
【be no longer adjective ↔ 不再处于某个状态】自己不再处于危险之中
they are no longer in danger

they [are no longer close]
【不再处于某个状态】他们不再亲近
---
【be no longer adjective ↔ 不再处于某个状态】他们不再亲近
they are no longer close

grammar.name: be similar to
grammar.text: 【含义】: 与...相似

examples.text:
science fiction movies [are] a little bit [similar to] fantasy
【与...相似】科幻小说电影与奇幻电影有点相似
---
【be similar to ↔ 与...相似】科幻小说电影与奇幻电影有点相似
science fiction movies are a little bit similar to fantasy

slice and chop [are similar to] each other
【与...相似】切和剁相似
---
【be similar to ↔ 与...相似】切和剁相似
slice and chop are similar to each other

grammar.name: cut...into
grammar.text: 【含义】: 将...切成

examples.text:
I want to [cut] things [into] perfect squares
【将...切成】我想将东西切成完美方块
---
【cut...into ↔ 将...切成】我想将东西切成完美方块
I want to cut things into perfect squares

grammar.name: make...do/make...adjective
grammar.text:
【含义】: 让宾语行动、让宾语状态变化
【翻译】：让、使
【注意】：有强迫之意

examples.text:
this action to [make] the potatoes [softer] and [mushy] is called mashing
【让】这个让土豆变软和黏的动作叫做 mashing
---
【让 ↔ make...do/make...adjective】这个让土豆变软和黏的动作叫做 mashing
this action to make the potatoes softer and mushy is called mashing

you don't need anybody to [make] you [happy]
【让】你无需任何人[使你快乐]
---
【让 - make...do/make...adjective】使你快乐
make you happy

the sudden movement can [make] the crab [feel] more threatened
【让】突然移动会[让螃蟹感到更大威胁]
---
【让 - make...do/make...adjective】让螃蟹感到更大威胁
make the crab feel more threatened

grammar.name: stick...into...
grammar.text: 【含义】：将什么扎进

examples.text:
we are going to [stick] the thermometer [into] the turkey and check the temperature
【将什么扎进】[我们要把温度计扎进火鸡里]，测测温度
---
【stick...into... - 将什么扎进】将温度计扎进火鸡里
we are going to stick the thermometer into the turkey

grammar.name: a sense of XXX
grammar.text: 【含义】：一种什么感觉

examples.text:
she has [a] good [sense of] humor
【一种什么感觉】她很有幽默感
---
【a sense of XXX - 一种什么感觉】她很有幽默感
she has a good  sense of humor

grammar.name: compare A to B
grammar.text: 【含义】：将 A 和 B 作比较

examples.text:
don't [compare] Canada [to] the United States
【将 A 和 B 作比较】不要将加拿大与美国相提并论
---
【compare A to B - 将 A 和 B 作比较】不要将加拿大与美国相提并论
don't compare Canada to the United States

grammar.name: it sounds adjective
grammar.text: 【含义】：听着如何

examples.text:
this expression sounds strange to native speakers
【听着如何】这种表达方式对母语者来说听着奇怪
---
【it sounds adjective - 听着如何】听着奇怪
this expression sounds strange to native speakers

grammar.name: no one does
grammar.text:
【含义】：没人怎么着
【注意】：动词要使用单数

examples.text:
[no one knows] how much time we have
【没人怎么着】没人知道我们有多少时间
---
【no one does - 没人怎么着】没人知道
no one knows how much time we have

grammar.name: it looks adjective
grammar.text: 【含义】：看着如何

examples.text:
this ice cream looks cool and refreshing
【看着如何】这个冰激凌看着清凉舒爽
---
【it looks adjective - 看着如何】这个冰激凌看着清凉舒爽
this ice cream looks cool and refreshing

grammar.name: imagine...doing
grammar.text: 【含义】：想象干什么

examples.text:
[imagine walking] barefoot along a sunny beach
【想象干什么】想象沿着阳光沙滩光脚行走
---
【imagine...doing - 想象干什么】想象行走
imagine walking barefoot along a sunny beach

[imagine] a planet of rotten eggs [engulfing] the Earth
【想象干什么】想象一个臭鸡蛋星球吞没地球
---
【imagine...doing - 想象干什么】想象...吞没
imagine a planet of rotten eggs engulfing the Earth

grammar.name: twice the property of A
grammar.text:
【含义】：两倍于 A 的某个属性
【注意】：twice is a adverb

examples.text:
another planetary object, [twice the size of Earth]
【两倍于 A 的某个属性】另一个天体，[地球体积的两倍]
---
【twice the property of A - 两倍于 A 的某个属性】地球体积的两倍
twice the size of Earth

that's more than [twice the bite force of a human molar]
【两倍于 A 的某个属性】那比[人类智齿咬力的两倍]还多
---
【twice the property of A - 两倍于 A 的某个属性】人类智齿咬力的两倍
twice the bite force of a human molar

grammar.name: as...as...
grammar.text:
【含义】：...到什么程度
【结构】：as noun/adjective/adverb as...
【技巧】：看弱第一个 as，视 ... as 为整体，即一个 noun/adjective/adverb

examples.text:
it would look just as [cool as] if the Earth was one of Jupiter's moons
【...到什么程度】它看起来就很酷，像地球是木星的月亮一样
---
【as...as ↔ ...到什么程度】它看起来就很酷，像地球是木星的月亮一样
it would look just as cool as if the Earth was one of Jupiter's moons

you don't have as [big a bubbles as] boil
【...到什么程度】你没有像煮那样的大泡
---
【as...as... ↔ ...到什么程度】像煮那样的大泡
you don't have as big a bubbles as boil

native speakers don't speak as [clearly as] I do
【...到什么程度】母语者不会讲的清晰到像我这样
---
【as...as... ↔ ...到什么程度】母语者不会讲的清晰到像我这样
native speakers don't speak as clearly as I do

I'm as [real as] you are
【...到什么程度】我和你一样真实
---
【as...as... ↔ ...到什么程度】和你一样真实
I'm as real as you are

You'll probably be about as [good as] I was
【...到什么程度】你大概会和我以前差不多
---
【as...as... ↔ ...到什么程度】和我以前差不多
You'll probably be about as good as I was

these asteroids can be as [big as] 240 km in diameter
【...到什么程度】这些小行星直径能达到240公里
---
【as...as... ↔ ...到什么程度】这些小行星直径能达到240公里
these asteroids can be as big as 240 km in diameter

grammar.name: shine down on
grammar.text: 【含义】：照耀着

examples.text:
Our sky would look gorgeous. Not only because of the ice giant [shining down on] us, but also thanks to many shooting stars
【照耀着】我们的天空看起来绚丽多彩。不仅因为[照耀着我们的那颗冰巨星]，还归功于许多流行
---
【shine down on - 照耀着】照耀着我们
the ice giant shining down on us

grammar.name: be the same as
grammar.text:
【含义】：和...一样
【注意】：same is an adjective

examples.text:
it is not exactly the same as sour
【和...一样】它和酸味不完全一样
---
【be the same as - 和...一样】它和酸味不完全一样
it is not exactly the same as sour

grammar.name: is free to do
grammar.text: 【含义】：随心所欲

examples.text:
a single individual [who is free to impose their vision]
【随心所欲】一个个体, [他随心所欲地施行自己愿景]
---
【is free to do - 随心所欲】他随心所欲地施行自己愿景
who is free to impose their vision

grammar.name: be composed of
grammar.text: 【含义】：构成

examples.text:
Uranus's atmosphere [is composed of] hydrogen sulfide
【构成】天王星的大气层由硫化氢构成
---
【be composed of - 构成】
Uranus's atmosphere is composed of hydrogen sulfide

grammar.name: it smells adjective
grammar.text: 【含义】：闻着如何

examples.text:
that part of the house is not going to [smell good]
【闻着如何】房子的那个部分不会好闻
---
【it smells adjective - 闻着如何】好闻
that part of the house is not going to smell good

Uranus smells like farts
【闻着如何】天王星闻着像屁
---
【it smells adjective - 闻着如何】天王星闻着像屁
Uranus smells like farts

grammar.name: be responsible for
grammar.text: 【含义】：对于...负有责任

examples.text:
the man most [responsible for] our enemies technological superiority
【对于...负有责任】对于我们敌人技术优势，负主要责任的人
---
【be responsible for - 对于...负有责任】
the man most responsible for our enemies technological superiority

the asteroid [responsible for] wiping dinosaurs off the face of the Earth
【对于...负有责任】对于恐龙从地球上灭绝，负有责任的小行星
---
【responsible for - 对于...负有责任】
the asteroid responsible for wiping dinosaurs off the face of the Earth

grammar.name: be short
grammar.text: 【含义】：不足

examples.text:
we'd [be short] on time, but at least we'd have a slight chance to evacuate the Earth
【不足】[时间上我们会不足]，但至少我们还有一线希望撤离地球
---
【be short - 不足】时间上我们会不足
we'd be short on time

grammar.name: live a xxx life
grammar.text: 【含义】：过着...的生活

examples.text:
Uranus [lived a quiet life] on the outskirts of the Solar System
【过着...的生活】天王星在太阳系边缘过着平静的生活
---
【live a xxx life - 过着...的生活】
Uranus lived a quiet life on the outskirts of the Solar System

grammar.name: attribute...to...
grammar.text: 【含义】：归功于

examples.text:
he [attributes] her power [to] grace not evil
【归功于】[他将她的力量归功于恩典]而非邪恶
---
【attribute...to... - 归功于】
he attributes her power to grace

grammar.name: describe...as...
grammar.text: 【含义】：说成

examples.text:
[Greek scholar described the Gorgon sisters as having scaled heads], large tusks and golden wings
【说成】[希腊学者将 Gorgon 姐妹说成长有鳞片头]，长牙，金翅膀
---
【describe...as... - 说成】：希腊学者将 Gorgon 姐妹说成长有鳞片头
Greek scholar described the Gorgon sisters as having scaled heads

grammar.name: bottle up emotions
grammar.text: 【含义】：压抑情绪

examples.text:
don't [bottle up your feelings]. If you feel sad, cry
【压抑情绪】[不要压抑你的情绪]。如果感到难过，就哭
---
【bottle up emotions - 压抑情绪】不要压抑你的情绪
don't bottle up your feelings

grammar.name: drown one's sorrows
grammar.text: 【含义】：借酒消愁

examples.text:
to [drown your sorrows] means to consume a lot of alcohol so that you will no longer feel sad
【借酒消愁】[借酒消愁]意思是喝很多酒，以不再感到难过
---
【drown one's sorrows - 借酒消愁】
drown your sorrows

grammar.name: be part of
grammar.text: 【含义】：属于、是整体的一部分

examples.text:
my husband's parents [are part of my family]
【属于】我丈夫的父母属于我的家人
---
【be part of - 属于】属于我的家人
my husband's parents are part of my family

grammar.name: in contact with
grammar.text: 【含义】：保持联系

examples.text:
To live in the moment means to enjoy each and every one that we come [in contact with]
【保持联系】活在当下意味着，要享受[我们接触到的所有]
---
【in contact with - 保持联系】
each and every one that we come in contact with

they are no longer [in contact with] each other
【保持联系】他们不再互相保持联系
---
【in contact with - 保持联系】
they are no longer in contact with each other

grammar.name: be made up of
grammar.text:
【含义】：组成
【注意】：be made of = 制成

examples.text:
a lot of the footage [is] not [made up of] actors
【组成】很多镜头并非由演员拍摄
---
【be made up of - 组成】 很多镜头并非由演员拍摄
a lot of the footage is not made up of actors

Your immediate family [is made up of] the people who are the most closely related to you
【组成】 你的直系亲属[由与你最密切相关的人组成]
---
【be made up of - 组成】 你的直系亲属由与你最密切相关的人组成
is made up of the people who are the most closely related to you

grammar.name: reach out to
grammar.text: 【含义】：联系

examples.text:
After many years of no communication, her estranged father [reached out to her] for the first time.
【联系】多年不联系，她疏远的父亲，首次[联系到她]
---
【reach out to - 联系】联系到她
reached out to her

grammar.name: in doing
grammar.text: 【含义】：在...过程中

examples.text:
this is an early step [in triggering the process of atherosclerosis]
【在...过程中】这是[引发动脉粥样硬化的过程中]的早期步骤
---
【in doing - 在...过程中】引发动脉粥样硬化的过程中
in triggering the process of atherosclerosis

I'm having some success [in calling them back]
【在...过程中】[在叫它们回来这件事上], 我有着[不错的效果]
---
【in doing - 在...过程中】在叫它们回来这件事上
some success in calling them back

grammar.name: part ways
grammar.text:
【含义】：分道扬镳
【注意】：中性表达，非消极

examples.text:
Your mother and father are living separately and [have parted ways]
【分道扬镳】你妈妈和爸爸分开住，[分道扬镳了]
---
【part ways - 分道扬镳】分道扬镳了
have parted ways

grammar.name: commit to sth
grammar.text: 【含义】：致力于某事

examples.text:
[Godparents will commit to praying for the child] and making sure they are helping to instill the child with good religious beliefs
【致力于某事】[教父母将致力于为孩子祈祷]，确保他们帮助孩子树立良好的宗教信仰。
---
【commit to sth- 致力于某事】教父母将致力于为孩子祈祷
Godparents will commit to praying for the child

grammar.name: get in on sth
grammar.text: 【含义】参与其中

examples.text:
volcanoes would begin erupting uncontrollably, and tremendous [earthquakes would get in on the act]
【参与其中】火山会不受控的喷发，同时巨大的[地震会参与进来]
---
【参与其中】地震会参与进来
earthquakes would get in on the act

You had an opportunity to [get in on] Starbucks
【参与其中】你有过一个参与投资星巴克的机会
---
【参与其中】参与投资
You had an opportunity to get in on Starbucks

grammar.name: triumph over sb
grammar.text:
【含义】：战胜
【结构】：自动词 triumph + prep

examples.text:
Perseus is reframed as a symbol of virtue, [triumphing over Medusa]
【战胜】Perseus 被重塑为正义的象征，[战胜美杜莎]
---
【triumph over sb - 战胜】
triumphing over Medusa

grammar.name: lead sb astray
grammar.text:
【含义】：误导、使之误入歧途
【结构】：astray is a adverb

examples.text:
a woman's power to [lead] men [astray]
【误导】一种女人误导男人的能力
---
【lead sb astray - 误导】
a woman's power to lead men astray

grammar.name: a vice incarnate
grammar.text: 【含义】：邪恶的化身

examples.text:
Medusa was seen as [vice incarnate]
【邪恶的化身】美杜莎被视作邪恶的化身
---
【a vice incarnate - 邪恶的化身】
Medusa was seen as vice incarnate

grammar.name: originate with
grammar.text: 【含义】：起源于

examples.text:
the mythological idea [originates with] ancient Greeks trying to explain the existence of prehistoric fossils
【起源于】这种神话观念[起源于古希腊人试图解释史前化石的存在]
---
【originate with - 起源于】
originates with ancient Greeks trying to explain the existence of prehistoric fossils

grammar.name: all the rage
grammar.text:
【含义】：all the = 全然，rage = 名词狂热，all the rage = 完全疯狂、非常流行
【成分】：noun

examples.text:
while the brown sauce was [all the rage] in Europe
【完全疯狂】在[那种褐色酱料在欧洲完全疯狂]的时候
---
【all the rage - 完全疯狂】
the brown sauce was all the rage in Europe

grammar.name: period
grammar.text:
【含义】：period 本意是句号
【翻译】：就这么简单、啥也不说了、不接受反驳

examples.text:
You want something. Go get it. [Period].
【就这么简单】你想做什么，就去做，[就这么简单]
---
【period - 就这么简单】
Period

grammar.name: ...type thing
grammar.text: 【含义】：什么之类的东西

examples.text:
the maintenance type things
【什么之类的东西】维修之类的事情 
---
【...type thing - 什么之类的东西】维修之类的事情 
the maintenance type things

grammar.name: be associated with
grammar.text: 【含义】：与什么有关

examples.text:
it has even [been associated with] shortened telomeres
【与什么有关】它甚至[与端粒缩短有关]
---
【be associated with - 与什么有关】：与端粒缩短有关
associated with shortened telomere

grammar.name: speaking of sth
grammar.text: 【含义】：说起什么事

examples.text:
[speaking of] digestion, does chronic stress affect your waistline?
【说起】[说起消化]，慢性压力影响你的腰围吗？
---
【speaking of sth - 说起】说起消化
speaking of digestion

grammar.name: be being adjective
grammar.text: 【含义】：显得

examples.text:
[you're being very rude]. you shouldn't be asking me this.
【显得】[你显得很没礼貌]. 你不应该问我这个
---
【be being adjective - 显得】你显得很没礼貌
you're being very rude

when we say I'm starving, [we are being dramatic] and over the top
【显得】当我们说我饿死了，[我们显得很夸张]，有点过
---
【be being adjective - 显得】我们显得很夸张
we are being dramatic

grammar.name: continue doing / continue to do
grammar.text: 【含义】：继续做某事

examples.text:
don't [continue sitting] there when there is an elderly man standing
【继续做某事】[不要继续坐在那]，当有老人站着时
---
【continue doing / continue to do - 继续做某事】不要继续坐在那
don't continue sitting there

grammar.name: a way into
grammar.text: 【含义】：通往...的道路

examples.text:
No monster has slithered [their way into our hearts], quite like the snake-haired seductress
【通往...的道路】[没有哪个怪物能爬出一条路进入我们内心]，像那个蛇发狐狸精那样
---
【a way into - 通往...的道路】没有哪个怪物能爬出一条路进入我们内心
No monster has slithered their way into our hearts

grammar.name: take shape
grammar.text: 【含义】：成型、初具规模

examples.text:
the modern Medusa [takes shape]
【成型】现代美杜莎的形象逐渐成形
---
【take shape - 成型】现代美杜莎的形象逐渐成形
the modern Medusa takes shape

grammar.name: not ... much
grammar.text: 【含义】：不太

examples.text:
they [didn't] think too [much] of them in old Paris
【不太】在老巴黎，[他们不太关心这些]
---
【not ... much 不太】他们不太关心这些
they didn't think too much of them

she['s not much] to look at
【不太】她不太值得一看
---
【not ... much 不太】她不太值得一看
she's not much to look at

grammar.name: go figure
grammar.text:
【含义】：直译为去想想吧
【翻译】：不可思议

examples.text:
The winged-horse on your book is the son of a snake-hair monster and the god of the sea. [Go figure]
【不可思议】你书上的飞马是蛇发怪兽和海神的儿子。[不可思议]
---
【go figure - 不可思议】
Go figure

grammar.name: spring forth
grammar.text:
【含义】：涌现
【注意】：forth 除了表示向前，还表示向外

examples.text:
when Perseus gives Medusa the old Marie Antoinette, two children [spring forth] from her body: Chrysaor and Pegasus
【涌现】珀尔修斯给了美杜莎留意十六妻子同样的结局，[两个孩子从她的体内涌现出来]：克律萨俄耳和飞马
---
涌现
two children spring forth from her body

grammar.name: sneak up on
grammar.text: 【含义】：悄悄接近

examples.text:
[Perseus sneaks up on the sleeping Gorgons], using his shield as a mirror to avoid looking Medusa in the eyes 
【悄悄接近】[珀尔修斯悄悄接近睡梦中的戈耳工]，使用他的盾牌作为镜子，避免直视美杜莎的眼睛
---
【sneak up on - 悄悄接近】珀尔修斯悄悄接近睡梦中的戈耳工
Perseus sneaks up on the sleeping Gorgons

grammar.name: avoid doing
grammar.text: 【含义】：避免做某事

examples.text:
Perseus sneaks up on the sleeping Gorgons, using his shield as a mirror to [avoid looking Medusa in the eyes]
【避免做某事】珀尔修斯悄悄接近睡梦中的戈耳工，使用他的盾牌作为镜子，[避免直视美杜莎的眼睛]
---
【avoid doing - 避免做某事】避免直视美杜莎的眼睛
avoid looking Medusa in the eyes

grammar.name: serves as
grammar.text: 【含义】：作为、充当

examples.text:
the senate had chosen him to [serve as] dictator with absolute power over the military and government
【充当】[参议院选择了他，作为领导者]，拥有凌驾于军队和政府之上的绝对权力
---
【serves as - 充当】参议院选择了他，作为领导者
the senate had chosen him to serve as dictator

a full bladder [serves as] a perfect breeding ground for many harmful bacteria
【充当】[憋满尿的膀胱可作为]许多有害细菌的[理想滋生场所]
---
【serves as - 充当】憋满尿的膀胱可作为许多有害细菌的理想滋生场所
a full bladder serves as a perfect breeding ground

grammar.name: in a matter of weeks
grammar.text: 【含义】：...的问题、...的事情

examples.text:
Cincinnatus set down his plow, took control and [in a matter of weeks], saved Rome.

she has been terrorizing and petrifying humanity for thousands of years

【用工具或技术】a
---

animated movies that are done [with] computer graphics
【用工具或技术】利用计算机图形技术制作的动画电影

【with 的用法 - 用工具或技术】利用计算机图形技术
animated movies that are done with computer graphics

some movies [with] some great action

some movies with some great action

【属性或状态 - 有】我总是会想到那些[拥有大房子的人]

we can call 911 to check [with] the pawlice

rinse the area [with] clean water

I stood there [with] my cash

cookbooks started popping up [with] all sorts of sauce recipes

telomeres shorten [with] each cell division

【with 的用法 - 交代背景 - 随着】：随着每次细胞分裂

grammar.name: noun, noun | 同位语
grammar.text:
【含义】：同位语。进一步解释前面的名词
【翻译】：也就是
【注意】：必须紧贴被修饰词

examples.text:
you have your kitchen, [the area where you make your food]
【同位语】你有你的厨房，[就是那个你做饭的区域]
---
【同位语】就是那个你做饭的区域

the burly coconut crab wields its massive pinchers to crack open coconut, [one of the toughest natural shells on the planet]
【同位语】体型健壮的椰子蟹挥舞着巨大的螯钳，打开椰子——[地球上最坚硬的天然外壳之一]。
---
【同位语】地球上最坚硬的天然外壳之一
one of the toughest natural shells on the planet

it has even been associated with shortened telomeres, [the shoelace tip ends of chromosomes]
【同位语】它甚至与端粒缩短有关，[也就是染色体的那些“鞋带尖端”]

grammar.name: …, doing…
grammar.text:
【含义】: 现在分词作伴随状语，交代主语所处的状态。
【翻译】：由于、着、不翻译
【注意】: 
-该动作由主句主语发出
-语法上可以理解为非限制性定语从句，补充主句的主语

examples.text:
pretty much every day they scour the property, [looking] for something that's out of place
【交代主语所处的状态】他们几乎每天都会仔细搜查这块地，[寻找一些不寻常的东西]
---
【…, doing… - 交代主语所处的状态】寻找一些不寻常的东西
looking for something that's out of place

you know my dream has always been just run away and become an artist, [living] in the garret, poor but free
【交代主语所处的状态】我的梦想一直是离家出走，成为一名艺术家，[住着阁楼]，穷但自由
---
【…, doing… - 交代主语所处的状态】住着阁楼
living in the garret

She used to sit at this bar every night, [wearing] every piece of jewelry she owned
【交代主语所处的状态】她过去每晚都会坐在这家酒吧里，[戴着她拥有的每件珠宝]
---
【…, doing… - 交代主语所处的状态】戴着她拥有的每件珠宝
wearing every piece of jewelry she owned

[struggling] with poverty and repeated failures, Hitler embraced this rhetoric
【交代主语所处的状态】[饱受贫困和屡次失败的困扰]，希特勒接受了这种论调。
---
【…, doing… - 交代主语所处的状态】饱受贫困和屡次失败的困扰
struggling with poverty and repeated failures

grammar.name: 双宾语结构
grammar.text:
【含义】: 有些动词本身带有 "给予"、"为某人做" 之意，所以可以先接人再接物，拥有两个宾语，相当于 do sth for sb
【结构】：show/make/build/buy + people + object
【翻译】：给…看/做/建

examples.text:
buy me a coffee
【双宾语】给我买杯咖啡
---
【双宾语】给我买杯咖啡
buy me a coffee

I think we should [show this boy how real I am]
【双宾语】我想我们应该[给这个男孩看看我有多真实]
---
【双宾语】给这个男孩看看我有多真实
show this boy how real I am

the town [built itself a grand old theater]
【双宾语】那个小镇[给自己建了一座宏伟的旧式的剧院]
---
【双宾语】给自己建了一座宏伟的旧式的剧院
built itself a grand old theater

I'm [making you a gourmet dinner]
【双宾语】我要[给你做一顿美味晚餐]
---
【双宾语】给你做一顿美味晚餐
making you a gourmet dinner

grammar.name: more than sth
grammar.text:
【含义】：超过、不仅仅
【词性】：prep

examples.text:
People tend to speak French [more than] they do English
人们倾向于讲法语[超过]讲英语
---
超过
more than

[more than] just an emotion, stress is a hardwired physical response
【超过】[不仅仅是一种情绪]，压力是一种硬性物理反应
---
【more than sth - 超过】不仅仅是一种情绪
more than just an emotion

that's [more than] twice the bite force of a human molar
【超过】那[超过]人类臼齿咬力的[两倍]
---
【more than sth - 超过】超过两倍
more than twice

they have roamed Earth's oceans or [more than] 200 million years
【超过】它们畅游地球海洋[超过200万年]
---
【more than sth - 超过】超过200万年
more than 200 million years

grammar.name: …, doing…
grammar.text:
【含义】：现在分词作结果状语，补充主句产生的后果
【翻译】：导致、致使、不翻译
【注意】：
-该结构不强调因果关系
-语法上可以理解为非限制性定语从句，修饰前面整个主句。

examples.text:
adrenaline causes your heart to beat faster and raises your blood pressure, over time [causing] hypertension
【补充主句产生的后果】肾上腺素导致你的心脏跳动更快，提升你的血压，[久而久之导致高血压]
---
【…, doing… - 补充主句产生的后果】久而久之导致高血压
over time causing hypertension

Not only that, the excess urine can flow back into the kidneys, [resulting] in infection
【补充主句产生的后果】不仅如此，多余的尿液会回流到肾脏中，[导致感染]
---
【…, doing… - 补充主句产生的后果】导致感染
resulting in infection

several F-35 stealth fighters punch a hole through the enemy lines, [destabilizing] their anti-air defenses
【补充主句产生的后果】几架F35隐形战机撕开敌人防线，[破坏了它们的防空系统]
---
【…, doing… - 补充主句产生的后果】破坏了它们的防空系统
destabilizing their anti-air defenses

grammar.name: 把字句
grammar.text:
【含义】： 把字句。主语对宾语行动处理
【结构】：have/get object done

examples.text:
you need to [have] the copies of all the documents [notarized] by a notary public
【把字句】你需要[把所有文件的副本]交给公证机关[公证]
---

they even [get] themselves [entangled] with a snake
【把字句】它们甚至[把自己跟蛇缠在一起]
---
【have/get object done - 把字句】把自己跟蛇缠在一起

【把字句】你把它做的那么大
---

they['ve got] you [trapped]

---

grammar.name: 使役句
grammar.text:
【含义】: 主语驱动宾语行动或状态变化
【结构】：let/make/have/get + object + do/adjective
【翻译】：让、使
【注意】：与把字句的区别是，object do 或 object adjective 是一个主动态结构
【例子】：
-the sudden movement can [make] the crab [feel] more threatened
-you don't need anybody to [make] you [happy]
-[make] each day [count]
-Wait. Just [let] me [hold] it in my hand
-this action to [make] the potatoes [softer] and [mushy] is called mashing

examples.text:
Wait. Just [let] me [hold] it in my hand
【使役句】等一下。[让我拿在手里]
---
【使役句 - object do 或 object adjective】让我拿在手里
let me hold it in my hand

grammar.name: 感官动词
grammar.text:
【含义】：see/watch/hear 等感官动词的用法
【句型】：
感官动词 do = 感知一件事，相当于宾语从句，I'd never seen (that) black people drink coffee
感官动词 doing = 感知宾语发出的动作，相当于后置定语，I see black people drinking(who is drinking) coffee

examples.text:
we'd just be left here, [watching] the end of times [unfold] in front of our eyes
【感观】我们将困在这里，[眼看着末日到来]
---
【感观】我们将困在这里，眼看着末日到来
watching the end of times unfold

you can [see] it [starting] to melt
【感观】你可以看到它开始化了
---
【感观】你可以看到它开始化了
you can see it starting to melt

I'd never [seen] black people [drink] coffee
【感观】我从没见过黑人喝咖啡
---
【感观】我从没见过黑人喝咖啡
I'd never seen black people drink coffee

every time I go to Starbucks, I [see] black people [drinking] coffee
【感观】每次我去星巴克，[我看见黑人在喝咖啡]
---
【感观】我看见黑人在喝咖啡

grammar.name: 假如
grammar.text:
【含义】: 大概率不会发生的假设
【句型】: 
假如 - if were
假如当时 - if had done
【注意】：
-它就是教材中讲的虚拟语气条件句，但那样学不利于理解
-注意普通假设不属于该句型，例如我是工薪阶层，如果我有2万块存款是可以实现的，所以用普通假设 if I have 20k

examples.text:

【假如】[假如他有兄弟]，那会是我的 brother-in-law
---
【if were / did / had done - 假如】假如他有兄弟
if he had a brother

[if she were alive], she'd be very proud
【假如】[假如他活着]，她会非常自豪
---
【if were / did / had done - 假如】假如他活着
if she were alive

grammar.name: both
grammar.text: 【含义】: 两个都。代指、限定、修饰两个相同特质的事物、动作。

examples.text:

【两个都】他俩都会说对不起
---
【两个都】他俩都会说对不起
they will both say sorry

[both Alberta and BC province] are well known for the Rocky Mountains
【两个都】[阿省和BC省都]以落基山著名
---

both Alberta and BC province

Both are tough. Both are smart.
【两个都】两位都强硬。两位都聪明。

【两个都】两位都强硬。两位都聪明。
Both are tough. Both are smart.

grammar.name: 新闻标题省略法
grammar.text:

【规则】：使用一般现在是、谓语被简化。
-be adjective -> adjective
-done 表示被动式而不是过去式：be done -> done
-be doing -> doing

a

Video [Ready] to Download!
a
---
【新闻标题省略法】is Ready
a

Iranian protester [no longer] sentenced to death after Trump warnings
a
---
【新闻标题省略法】are no longer
a

grammar.name: for 的用法
grammar.text:
【含义一：以什么代价】
【含义二：指向：对】
【含义三：当作、作为】
【含义四：引出总数，总计】

examples.text:
we have three territories and ten provinces [for] a total of 13 different areas
【引出总数 - 总计】我们拥有三个领地，十个省，[总计13个不同地区]
---
【for 的用法 - 引出总数 - 总计】总计13个不同地区
for a total of 13 different areas

she's got snakes [for] hair
【当作】她以蛇为发
---
【for 的用法 - 当作】她以蛇为发
she's got snakes for hair

whatever you have a love [for]
【指向 - 对】任何你热爱的东西
---
【for 的用法 - 指向 - 对】任何你热爱的东西
whatever you have a love for

a taste [for] the salty condiment
【指向 - 对】对那种咸味调味品的喜爱
---
【for 的用法 - 指向 - 对】对那种咸味调味品的喜爱
a taste for the salty condiment

just two ice creams [for] bloody nine pounds. nine quid [for] two. yes nine quid.
【以什么代价】[就两个冰激凌要特么9镑. 9块钱俩.] 是的9块钱.
---
【for 的用法 - 以什么代价】就两个冰激凌要特么9镑
just two ice creams for bloody nine pounds. nine quid for two.

don't take it [for] granted
【当作】不要把它当作理所当然
---
【for 的用法 - 当作】不要把它当作理所当然
don't take it for granted

grammar.name: ask 的用法
grammar.text:
【ask sb sth - 问某人某事】
【ask sb about sth - 问某人关于某事】
【ask sb for sth - 要东西】
【ask sb to do - 要求某人做某事】
【ask to do - 要求】

examples.text:
[ask] people [about] their hobbies
【问某人关于某事】询问人们的爱好
---
【ask sb about sth - 问某人关于某事】询问人们的爱好
ask people about their hobbies

when talking about books with other people, they might [ask you your opinion] on a certain book
【问某人某事】当与他人谈论书籍时，他们可能会[问你对某本书的看法]
---
【ask sb sth - 问某人某事】问你对某本书的看法
ask you your opinion on a certain book

grammar.name: …, done…
grammar.text:
【含义】：过去分词作伴随状语，交代主语所处的状态（被动）
【翻译】：如果、一旦
【注意】: 
-由主句主语承受该动作
-作用与现在分词做伴随状语类似

examples.text:
[given] a fair shot, [given] a fair chance, Americans have never let their country down
【交代主语所处的状态（被动）】[给个公平的尝试]，[给个公平的机会]，美国人从没让他们的国家失望过
---
【…, done… - 交代主语所处的状态（被动）】：给个公平的尝试，给个公平的机会
given a fair shot, given a fair chance

grammar.name: as...
grammar.text:
【含义】：补充动作发生的方式
【词性】：prepostion
【翻译】：以…方式

examples.text:
high levels of cortisol can also cause you to put on those extra calories [as] deep belly fat
【以…方式】皮质醇水平过高也会导致你摄入额外的卡路里[以深层腹部脂肪的形式]
---
【as - 以…方式】以深层腹部脂肪的形式
as deep belly fat

I will do [as] my mother asked
【以…方式】我会[按我母亲要求的]做
---
【as - 以…方式】按我母亲要求的
as my mother asked

grammar.name: as...
grammar.text:
【含义】: 在作演讲或报告等叙述场景下，用于衔接同时进展的两件事。
【词性】：conjunction
【翻译】: 随着、因为、当或不翻译
【注意】:
----它不像 because 那样强调逻辑关系
----它不是 before 或 after，而是在前面事件未结束时，后面事件就会发生，并且二者同时进展。
----常使用过去式
----有时翻译成“因为”是因为在汉语中“随着”本身就有一种弱的因果逻辑
----有时翻译成“当”是因为事件发展可能很短暂

examples.text:
Maduro shock and awe froze him [as] Delta Force breached the compound
【随着】[随着三角洲部队攻入院子]，马杜罗的震惊和敬畏让他愣住了
---
【随着】随着三角洲部队攻入院子
as Delta Force breached the compound

By 1945, [as] Allied forces closed in on Berlin, Hitler retreated to his underground bunker
【随着】到了1945年，[随着盟军逼近柏林]，希特勒撤到了他的地堡中
---
【随着】随着盟军逼近柏林
as Allied forces closed in on Berlin

On April 30, 1945, [as] Soviet troops entered the city, Hitler took his own life
【随着】1945年4月30日，[随着苏联部队进入城市]，希特勒结束了自己的声明
---
【随着】随着苏联部队进入城市
as Soviet troops entered the city

grammar.name: 主系表结构
grammar.text:
【含义】：用于描述主语的状态、性质、特征、内容。
【结构】：subject + linking verb + 表语
【例子】：
-[smell/sound/appear/seem + noun/abjective = 说明主语的状态]
-The house is not going to smell good. 那房子不会好闻。
-It appears that the Empire has mounted a full scale assault. 看来帝国发动了全面袭击。
-The pronunciation of the number four sounds the same as the word of death. 数字四的发音听起来跟死的发音一样。
-To them, your hand might look like a rival, an intruding predator, or just something that got too close for comfort.
-
-[be + infinitive = 解释主语是干什么的]
-If we get wet from this rain, there are two great collocations for that. One is to be soaked to the skin or to be soaked to the bone.
-We also have two specific collocations we can use for enjoying sunlight. There are to soak up the sun or to soak up some rays.
-My job is to look after the old in the nursing home.
-The best strategy is not to yank your hand away immediately.
-
-[be + infinitive = 法律、行政、遗嘱等文件中的命令、指示、规定]
-In her will, Mary stated that her dummies were to be buried with her. 玛丽在遗嘱中声明，她的玩偶要和她葬在一起。
-Both parties are to cease all hostilities within 24 hours. 双方必须在24小时内停止一切敌对行动。
-
-[be+ adverb]
-she is here

grammar.name: Passive Voice
grammar.text:
【含义】：被动式，主语被动承受动作
【结构】：be + done
【注意】：该结构一定使用动词的过去分词，而不是过去式
------------// 一般现在时
------------The meal is cooked by the chef.
------------Both Alberta and British Columbia are well known for the Rocky Mountains, which are sometimes just called the Rockies.
------------// 一般过去时
------------The tree was pulled down.
------------// 现在进行时
------------A bridge is being built.
------------// 现在完成时
------------The work has been finished.
------------// 含情态动词
------------The window can be opened.

grammar.name: 什么情况下使用动词原形
grammar.text:
--------[情态动词]:
------------[can]
------------[would]
------------[must]
--------[感官动词]: 侧重描述\"动作相关的事实\"，而不是\"动作本身\"。
------------[see-看见]: For now, we can stay here for a while. Cause you know, I just wanna see you smile.
------------[see-看见]: I'd never seen black people drink coffee. 黑人喝咖啡
------------[see-看见]: So now, every time I go to Starbucks, I see black people drinking coffee. 黑人在喝咖啡
------------[hear]: 
------------[watch]: 
------------[notice]: 
------------[feel]: 
------------[make-让]: He made me wait.
------------[let-让]: She let him go.
------------[have]: 
--------[Causative-使役结构中使宾语行动的情况]
------------[make-使]: The sudden movement can make the crab feel more threatened.
--------[help (sb) do sth]: 美式使用 Base Verb，英式则使用 Infinitive
------------They do certainly help reduce the number of pests on your property.
------------The superintendent usually lives on the property and helps take care of all the maintenance type things.

grammar.name: get
grammar.text:
【含义一】：主语获得具体东西。
-Can you get a drink for me? 能帮我弄杯喝的吗？
-I have got a car. 我有了一辆车
【含义二】：主语的状态发生变化。将其视为固定词组的一部分，这样容易理解和记忆。
-[get home-回家]: I will get home in 10 minutes. 
-[get fed-喂]: Our cats get fed twice a day
-[get to know-了解,熟悉]: As I got to know him. 随着我越加了解他
-[get ready for-准备]: Getting ready for school play
-[got to-不得不。即过去或完成式表示状态变化完成]: I have got to work. 我得工作了
-[got to-不得不。即过去或完成式表示状态变化完成]: I got to flush all the toilets? 我得冲所有的厕所？
-[got to-不得不。即过去或完成式表示状态变化完成]: You got to move out. 你得搬家了.（用完成式表示状态变化完成 -> 必须）必须）
【注意】：
-翻译时，不翻译，或加一个程度副词+动词。
-"使变化"归到使役结构。
-Get 与 Have 都能表示 "有"，虽然意思相同，但形态不相关。
--I have got a car. ("have got" is the past participle of "get")
--I have a car. (have)
-Get 与 Have 都能表示 "状态变化"，虽然意思相同，但形态不相关。
--I have got to work. ("have got" is the past participle of "get")
--I have to work. (have)
-Get 经常以完成式出现，这个结构包含一个 have，但它是结构助词，与 have 无关。
--I have got a car. ("have got" is the past participle of "get")
--I have got to work. ("have got" is the past participle of "get")

examples.text:
you break up with that person, or you [get divorced]
【…了】你和那个人分手了，或者[你离婚了]
---
【get adjective - …了】你离婚了
you get divorced

when you have finished your meal and you [are getting ready] to pay
【…了】当你吃完了，[你要准备付钱]
---
【get adjective - …了】你要准备付钱
you are getting ready to pay

grammar.name: 完成式
grammar.text:
【含义】：用已经结束的动作表示由来已久的状态。
【结构】：have/had + done
【翻译】：...了, ...过
--------住了：How long have you lived in that house?
--------弹了：How long have you played piano?
--------有过：We've had candidates before attempted to get elected by appealing to our fears
--------遨游了：They have roamed Earth's oceans or more than 200 million years.
--------没明白过：I have never understood why some people are lucky enough to be born with the chance that I had",

examples.text:
I'[ve thought] about it for years
【由来已久的状态：...了】 我考虑了好几年了
---
【由来已久的状态 - ...了】 我考虑了好几年了
I've thought about it for years

grammar.name: Adverbial Clause of Concession
grammar.text:
【含义】： 让步状语从句。强调主句发生的必然性。即从句所描述的情况尽管存在，但主句所描述的事情仍然发生。
【句型】：
, ...even though - 虽然
although... - 尽管
no mater... - 无论

examples.text:
I love you [even though] you're a chonker
【让步状语从句】我爱你，[虽然你是个大胖子]
---
【让步状语从句 - 虽然】虽然你是个大胖子
even though you're a chonker

[although] most of Canada tries to be bilingual, they really aren't
【让步状语从句】[尽管加拿大大部分地区努力成为双语的]，但它们真的不是
---
【让步状语从句 - 尽管】尽管加拿大大部分地区努力成为双语的
although most of Canada tries to be bilingual

[no matter] where he saw me, it was a challenge
【让步状语从句】[无论他在哪看见我]，那都是一个挑战
---
【让步状语从句 - 无论】无论他在哪看见我
no matter where he saw me

grammar.name: Adverbial Clause of Result
grammar.text:
【含义】：结果状语从句，补充主句引发的后果
【翻译】：以至于

examples.text:
the operators breached the room [so] fast [that] his security could not even react
【结果状语从句 - 以至于】队员们攻破房间[如此之快，以至于他的护卫无法做出反应]
---
【结果状语从句 - 以至于】队员们攻破房间如此之快，以至于他的安全员无法做出反应
so fast that his security could not even react

grammar.name: Adverbial Clause of Condition
grammar.text:
【含义】：条件状语从句，交代主句发生的条件
【句型】：
if - 如果
...once... - 一旦
...unless... - 除非
...as long as... - 只要

examples.text:
most crabs will release their hold [once] they feel they are no longer trapped
【交代条件信息 - 一旦】多数螃蟹会松掉钳子，[一旦他们觉得他们不在被困住]
---
【交代条件信息 - 一旦】一旦他们觉得他们不在被困住
once they feel they are no longer trapped

they're not in the will [unless] they get two degrees
【交代条件信息 - 除非】他们不会在遗嘱里，[除非他们获得两个学位]
---
【交代条件信息 - 除非】除非他们获得两个学位
unless they get two degrees

grammar.name: Adverbial Clause of Time
grammar.text:
【含义】：时间状语从句，交代主句发生的时间
【句型】：
when - 当时
every time - 每次
while - 在期间
before - 在之前

examples.text:
[While] in jail, he wrote My Struggle
【交代时间信息 - 期间】[服刑期间]，他写了我的奋斗
---
【交代时间信息 - 期间】服刑期间
While in jail

I bought it [when] it was 25,000 square feet
【交代时间信息 - 当时】我买的，[当时它 25,000 平尺]
---
【交代时间信息 - 当时】当时它 25,000 平尺
when it was 25,000 square feet

[every time] I thought about selling it, I thought of Cal
【交代时间信息 - 每次】[每次我考虑卖掉它]，我想起卡尔
---
【交代时间信息 - 每次】每次我考虑卖掉它
every time I thought about selling it

grammar.name: 非限制性定语从句
grammar.text:
【含义】：补充性关系从句。被逗号隔开的，用于补充说明前面的名词或整个句子的从句，在整个句子里作状语。
【结构】：逗号 + 关系代词(that禁止使用. 在从句中主要作主语和宾语) + 从句
【注意】：
-翻译时修饰部分要放在最后面，像是可有可无的题外话。
-现在分词作伴随、结果状语，也可以视作该句型的简写。

examples.text:
"this program contains coarse language. viewer discretion is advised", [which means there is swearing in this program] so if there's children now is the time to get them to leave the room or turn off the TV
【为前面的句子补充信息】“本节目包含粗俗语言，敬请观众酌情观看” [这意味着本节目中有脏话]，所以如果有孩子在场，现在就应该让他们离开房间或关掉电视
---
【为前面的句子补充信息】这意味着本节目中有脏话
which means there is swearing in this program

there's a woman just like me with the same abilities and the same desires, [who would most likely make better films] and better speeches
【为前面的主语补充信息】有一位女性和我一样，拥有相同的能力和愿望，[她很可能会拍出更好的电影]，发表更精彩的演讲
---
【为前面的主语补充信息】她很可能会拍出更好的电影
who would most likely make better films

grammar.name: Relative Clause
grammar.text:
【含义】：定语从句。用于修饰和限定一个名词，并紧跟其后的从句。
【结构】：先行词 + 关系代词(在从句中主要作主语和宾语) + 从句
【结构】： 翻译时修饰部分要放在名词前，虽然它可能很长。
--------[when-adverb-修饰时刻]: fog is the type of weather when there is tiny bits of moisture in the air
--------[when-adverb-修饰时间]: I remember the day when we met.
--------[who-pronoun-修饰人]: The girl who sings well is my sister.
--------[who-pronoun-修饰人]: The person who you met yesterday is my boss.
--------[whose-修饰人]: The man whose car was stolen called the police.
--------[which-pronoun-修饰物]: The book which is on the table is mine.
--------[which-pronoun-修饰物]: The movie which you recommended was great.
--------[where-adverb-修饰地点]: This is the house where I was born.
--------[why-adverb-解释原因]: That is the reason why he left early

grammar.name: Nominal Clause
grammar.text:
【含义】：名词性从句。使用完整句子描述一个事物或事情，成分等同于名词。它在主句中是什么成分就是什么从句。
【注意】：主语在前、谓语在后
【结构】：关系代词/副词/连词 引导一个句子。关系词在从句中可作任何成分。
--------关系代词：Ice cream, coke, hamburgers, whatever you have a love for. 
--------关系代词：Kobe gave every last ounce of himself to whatever he was doing.
--------关系代词：Whatever it is, it's too late.
--------关系副词：I don’t know when he will come.
--------关系副词：Tell me why you were late.
--------关系连词：I don't know whether he will come.
--------关系连词：Tell me if you need help

examples.text:
that's [why we must live in the moment]
【句子充当名词】那就是[为什么我们必须活在当下]
---
【句子充当名词】那就是为什么我们必须活在当下
why we must live in the moment

we don't even know [if it works]
【句子充当名词】我们甚至不知道[它是否有效]
---
【句子充当名词】：我们甚至不知道它是否有效
if it works

asking somebody [how old they are is considered rude]
【句子充当名词】问[别人多大]被认为是不礼貌的
---
【句子充当名词】：问别人多大被认为是不礼貌的
how old they are

she worries about [what her children will eat]
【句子充当名词】她担心[孩子们会吃什么]
---
【句子充当名词】：她担心孩子们会吃什么
what her children will eat

grammar.name: 使用 noun 的思路
grammar.text:
【Input】
1. 以 the 开头是在强调事物
-the cat 那只猫
-the cats 那些猫
-in the winter..., in the summer 在冬天如何，在夏天如何
2. 单数在表示一个事物、复数在表示多个事物、非单非复在表示抽象概念
-a cat 一只猫
-two coffees 两杯咖啡
-vocabulary is the sum of many words
【Output】
1. 要强调事物，则以 the 开头
-the cat 那只猫
-the cats 那些猫
-in the winter..., in the summer 在冬天如何，在夏天如何
2. 要表示"可被单位化"、"成个存在"的事物则必须加 a 或 s、要表示抽象概念则使用裸词
-a cat 一只猫
-two cats 两只猫
-a water 一片水域
-a attachment 依赖是一种心里状态
-vocabulary 词汇
-love 感情
-an ice cream 一支冰淇淋，使用 an 的根本原因，是名词以元音开头不容易发音，与前面的 n 形容连读，更容易发音。an ice 发音时只需发 n + ice 即可，a 可以省略

grammar.name: 单词变形规则
grammar.text:
【plural】
----[+s]: invents
----[+es]: touches
----[y +ies]: studies
【past & past participle】
----[+d]: tortured
----[+ed]: invented
----[-y +ied]: carried
----[+辅 +ed]: stopped
【gerund】
----[+ing]: inventing
----[-e +ing]: whistling
----[+辅 +ing]: stopping

grammar.name: 撇号 ' 的作用
grammar.text:
【含义】：表示省略了某些字母，起到展位的作用
【结构】：常省略 a, i, g
【例子】：
----I'm student
----dyin' was a part of life
----you're not coming out

grammar.name: 日期
grammar.text:
【规则】
-day = 0:00 ~ 24:00
-night = 21:00 ~ 00:00
-在 year & month 要使用介词 in
-在 day 要使用介词 on
-在 night 要使用介词 at
-month & date 要大写: November, Monday
-day 的读法:  1~3(first, second, third), 24~29(fourth~ninth)

examples.text:
【读法】：on November 21, on November 24
a
---
【日期 - Day 的读法】on November twenty first, on November twenty fourth
a

in November

grammar.name: Subordinating Conjunction
grammar.text:
【含义】: 从属连词。用于引导从句，为主句补充信息。

-汉语角度，原因、条件等信息是必要背景和前提，要先交代。而英语角度，从句就是在给主句补充信息，主句先说、从句作为补充。
-虽然连词可以引导完整句子，从逻辑上，它不能独立成句。
【种类】:
-[time]: after, before, when, while, as, since, until, once, as soon as。
-[condition]: if, unless, in case, provided that, as long as。
-[concession]: although, though, even though, while。
-[reason]: because, as, since, in order that, so that。
-[nomial]: that, if, whether

grammar.name: Coordinating Conjunction

【含义】：并列连词，用于连接两个主句或结构相同的成分。
【种类】：for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so, 简称 fanboys
【注意】：只要符合逻辑，它可以独立成句。
-不推荐使用 But 开启独立句子。推荐使用副词 However
-不推荐使用 So 开启独立句子。推荐使用副词 Therefore
-不推荐使用 Or else 开启独立句子。荐使用副词 Otherwise
【示例】：
-[but]: But you have a sense of love for him in the way that he can bring out the best in you.
-[but - Not only 是副词成分并引发了倒装]: Not only do we have the largest economy in the world, we have the strongest economy in the world.
-[but]: he is remembered not just as a man who rose to power through manipulation and violence, but as a symbol of the dangers of hatred and unchecked power.
-[and]: And he did that for me.
-[or else-否则] As I look in this arena and across the globe, a piece of you died, or else you wouldn't be here.
-[or else-否则] You can't replace one of the words, or else expression sounds strange to native speakers.
-[or - either 是副词性成分]: What will happen if there is a swear word on Canadian TV? Either the swear word will be censored, or at the beginning of the program there will be a warning.
-[nor - neither 是副词性成分]
